question: Should `src/agents` establish a shared `agents` parent logger now, despite this PR converting only `agent-command`?
rationale: Both implementations are behaviorally correct; the unresolved choice is whether the additional module is a useful owner boundary or premature indirection under the repository's lean-code guidance.

options.title: Keep direct logger
options.body: Retain the current direct `agents/agent-command` logger until at least one additional concrete caller needs the shared parent.

options.title: Sponsor shared parent
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, resolve conflicts, and identify the intended sibling consumers before landing the parent logger.

recommendation.title: Keep direct logger
recommendation.body: Retain the current direct `agents/agent-command` logger until at least one additional concrete caller needs the shared parent.

likelyOwner.reason: The current `agent-command` owner boundary was established by their agents-layer refactor, and their subsequent history covers the same structural surface.
